ecbench.pricing: priced S = recorded S + F4 word XORs * pinned ns_per_word_xor (docs/ic/calibration.json, another host) / sqrt(r); a sensitivity, not the recorded S. AGENTS.md 5a band: S_w = recorded S + w * (every unpriced op of the arm) / sqrt(r), w in {0, 0.1, 1}, every arm alike, rho included; an order is reported only if it holds at every weight on every workload

ladder.rule: growth = (cost_k2/cost_k1)^(1/(k2-k1)) on mean XORs per branch; enumeration is 2

projection_rule: S_relations = (F+1)/lambda * mean_word_xors * ns_per_word_xor / sqrt(r); relation phase only; pinned ratio from another host
